facts.fact: Launch Base Africa reports that the FindMe-Campost agreement signed in 2024 laid the groundwork for a country-wide Plan de Localisation Postal to standardize addressing in line with international postal standards.

Launch Base Africa reports that around 15,000 Cameroonians have generated geolocated addresses on FindMe's platform since the 2024 Campost agreement, certified through national postal partnerships for 2,000 CFA francs.

Launch Base Africa reports that CCA-Bank will require every new customer to provide a certified FindMe digital address to open an account or apply for credit, affecting more than 700,000 clients, and that 10+ local partners are integrating the system.

slug: 2024-11-04 Cameroon's Campost partners with FindMe to improve national address system

facts.fact: Business in Cameroon reports Campost signed a partnership with FindMe on 1 November 2024 in Yaounde to enhance the national address system.
Business in Cameroon reports FindMe's postal-addressing model, already deployed in Senegal, has been operational in Cameroon since July 2024.

Ecomatin reports that the Plan de Localisation Postale, produced by Campost and operated by the startup FindMe through its FindMe.House app, provides certified addresses linked to GPS maps, has been deployed for nearly two years, and stands at about 15,000 addresses against a target of 100,000 by end-2025.

CCA Bank, Campost and FindMe signed an agreement on 17 June 2025 to align the PLP with the bank's account-opening and credit procedures; FindMe's CEO says CCA Bank is the first bank to integrate the document in its procedures, and the PLP can also serve as proof of address for administrative procedures.
